h1: Video production Lahore brands post every week, not once a year
intro: We make short-form reels, brand films, motion graphics, 2D and 3D explainers and clearly labelled AI video for established Lahore businesses. Content is planned around what sells, scripted in Urdu, English or both, cut for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and WhatsApp, and delivered on a steady schedule so your channels never go quiet.

sections.h: The problem: one expensive shoot, then silence
p: A familiar pattern in Lahore: a brand pays for a big campaign shoot before a collection launch or an Eid sale, posts it for two weeks and then goes back to phone photos and reposted stories. Meanwhile the competitor down the road on MM Alam Road posts three reels a week and wins the attention.
Video works when it is regular. Our approach is a monthly plan that mixes a few produced pieces with a steady flow of short edits, so there is always something new for the feed and the ads.

Good video production Lahore audiences respond to also looks like it belongs on the platform. A polished television-style advert often performs worse on TikTok than a well-lit, well-cut clip of a real person explaining the product, so we plan the look for each channel rather than one master film.

sections.h: Urdu, English and Roman Urdu captions
p: Most people watch with the sound off, so captions are not optional. We script and caption in the language your audience uses: Urdu for a family audience, English for exporters and premium brands, Roman Urdu captions for social posts where that is how people type. Voiceovers are recorded in the matching language and tone, and every video is cut in vertical, square and wide versions so it fits wherever it runs.

AI video can produce ad variations in hours and presenters who speak several languages. It is useful for testing hooks, localising explainers and making content at volume. We label AI-generated material clearly, never put words in a real person's mouth without their written approval and have a person review every frame before it goes out. That protects your brand and keeps you on the right side of platform rules.

sections.h: Proof: live events where the date does not move
p: We have run and broadcast more than 20 large-scale live events. Live work teaches one lesson fast: the date does not move. Cameras, graphics, sound and streaming all have to work at the stated hour. That discipline carries into every content calendar we run, including the Lahore launch that has to go live the night before Eid.

Talk: your goals, audience, platforms and the products that make the most money. Plan: a monthly content calendar with formats, scripts and shoot needs, signed off in writing. Build: production, editing, captions and versions for each platform. Grow: we read the numbers each month, keep the formats that hold attention and drop the ones that do not.

For live-action footage we either work with what your team films to a shot list we provide, or arrange a shoot in Lahore when the project needs it. Reviews happen on a shared link with frame-accurate comments, and calls are booked at times that suit your team.

faqs.q: What does video production in Lahore cost with 22 Signals?
faqs.a: It depends on scope. The main factors are the number of videos a month, whether they need a shoot or can be made with animation, AI or your own footage, scripting and voiceover languages, and how many platform versions you need. We price after a short call and a written brief.

faqs.q: How many reels should a Lahore brand post each week?
faqs.a: For most consumer brands, two to four short videos a week keeps a feed active without exhausting the team or the audience. Consistency matters more than volume. We usually start with a manageable number, track which formats hold attention and add more once the pipeline is running smoothly.

We arrange shoots in Lahore when a project needs them, for example a brand film or a collection launch. Much of our work does not need a crew on site: animation, AI video, editing your own footage, and content filmed by your team to our shot list and direction.

faqs.q: Do you make animated explainers in Urdu?
faqs.a: Yes. We write the script, record Urdu or English voiceover, design the visuals and animate in 2D or 3D. Urdu explainers work well for products aimed at families, patients or customers who prefer their own language, and we can make an English version from the same animation.

faqs.q: Is AI video suitable for our brand?
faqs.a: It suits ad testing, quick variations, explainers and localising content into several languages. It suits less well when authenticity is the point, such as bridal or a doctor's introduction. We label AI-generated material, get approval for any likeness and review every video before it is published.

faqs.q: What is a managed editing team?
faqs.a: It is a team of editors we run for you, turning raw footage into finished videos every week to an agreed style and schedule. We run one for a US client already. You send footage and briefs, we return edited content with captions and versions for each platform.

faqs.q: How long does video production take?
faqs.a: A short reel from existing footage is the quickest. A brand film with a shoot takes longer from script to final cut, and an animated explainer depends on length and style. Every deadline is agreed in writing before work starts.
